notes.title: New update adds Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, plus optimisation!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've just released an update to the game that adds the promised new languages:

[list]
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[/list]
We've also spent the last few months working hard on optimising the game, both for faster loading times and better performance. That means it'll run better on lower end machines, and even use less battery on the Steam Deck.

We've had good reason to go after optimisation this strongly: we've also just launched Crow Country on Nintendo Switch! Plus, in just 6 days time, we'll be releasing on PS4. Like I said, Adam and I have been busy.

And finally, a little teaser of some more exciting news coming very soon...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716389/48ad0eead62185af14a4aca733adf140f9924d76.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716389/7696ef0e198499a59dc90c2cc5689731f25c655e.jpg[/img]

What could it all mean...? Not long to wait!

As always, thank you so much for your support for Crow Country, it's what's gotten us through the last few months. The updates aren't done, so stay tuned for more news!

Tom & Adam

notes.title: Hard Mode Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Since launch, the most requested feature for Crow Country has been a new hard mode. 

Today we're very pleased to announce that the new 'MURDER OF CROWS' mode is out!
[list]
[*] Resources are more limited
[*] Enemies are more aggressive
[*] You can't run while seriously hurt
[*] New rank requirements
[*] Bonus unlockable for completing hard mode
[/list]
The new mode is available right away, for first time players and seasoned Crow Pros alike! 

We've also included some additional changes to this build:
[list]
[*] Better full-screen handling
[*] Small bugfixes
[*] Small typo fixes
[/list]
We hope you'll enjoy 'MURDER OF CROWS' mode

Tom & Adam

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716389/96f37a562e011a55b072d58b749c8aedd5786fd2.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes 14th May
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Adam and I have tackled a bunch of reported issues, mostly small but some that were preventing progress for a small set of players. Changes detailed below:

[list]
[*] Fixed grenade spawn issue
[*] Fixed final boss animation glitch after rapid damage
[*] Fixed final boss sequence player getting trapped in fence
[*] Fixed mini-boss alternative defeat not counting for the achievement
[*] Fixed some environment colliders to prevent trapping the player
[*] Fixed some typos
[*] Fixed some UK English spellings into US English, so as not to break the V I B E
[*] Fixed German gift shop puzzle translation
[/list]

notes.title: Crow Country Content Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We've been watching folks play and reading lots of feedback all weekend, and we'd like to share a roadmap with you for what's coming next in Crow Country!

[b]Very soon[/b]:
[list]
[*] Bug fixes to all current platforms
[*] A digital release of Ockeroid's Crow Country Soundtrack
[/list]
[b]Soon[/b]:
[list]
[*] Hard Mode
[*] Steam Trading Cards
[*] A change: once unlocked, the CrowQuest Reward will be a permanent setting in the menu
[/list]
[b]Soon-ish[/b]:
[list]
[*] Additional Languages: Japanese, Italian, Korean, Chinese
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716389/df691ffca811b890b30dfd9c4f26c6ed1c24b470.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo update notes + thanks for all the feedback so far!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thank you all so much for the amazing response to our announcement and the demo! It's gone even better than we'd hoped, and we've had so many lovely comments and thoughtful pieces of feedback. This last week has been very encouraging for our tiny team!

We've updated the demo build with some bug fixes and a few small changes to make things better, the details are all below. There are a few other known issues we'll address soon too.

Thanks again for playing!
Adam & Tom


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Limited frame rate to 60fps
[*]Fixed enemies and items respawning after loading a saved game
[*]Fixed issues with Mara switching between walk and run animations
[*]Fixed gap in the wall in Fairytale Town
[*]Fixed game switching between windowed and fullscreen without user input
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Bear traps now hurt enemies when they're triggered by the handgun
[*]Made pocket light and laser sight slightly more noticeable on the ground
[*]Made fairy pond curtain slightly more noticeable, and mentioned it in the staff memo
[/list]
